meta.name: file-processing-report
meta.description: Validate text inputs, normalize file content, aggregate metrics, and render a promotable report artifact.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

source_dir = pathlib.Path("{params.source_dir}")
if not source_dir.is_dir():
    raise SystemExit("source_dir is not a directory: " + str(source_dir))

files = sorted(path for path in source_dir.glob("*.txt") if path.is_file())
if not files:
    raise SystemExit("source_dir does not contain any .txt files: " + str(source_dir))

records = []
for path in files:
    text = path.read_text().strip()
    if not text:
        raise SystemExit("input file is empty: " + path.name)
    line_count = sum(1 for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip())
    records.append(dict(name=path.name, source_path=str(path.resolve()), line_count=line_count))

out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/validate")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = dict(title="{params.report_title}", source_dir=str(source_dir.resolve()), files=records)
(out_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

manifest = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/validate_files/manifest").read_text())
out_root = pathlib.Path("../outputs/transform")
files_dir = out_root / "files"
files_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
index = []
for record in manifest["files"]:
    source = pathlib.Path(record["source_path"])
    normalized_lines = [line.strip().upper() for line in source.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    target = files_dir / record["name"]
    target.write_text("\n".join(normalized_lines) + "\n")
    index.append(dict(name=record["name"], local_path="files/" + record["name"], line_count=len(normalized_lines)))
(out_root / "index.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(files=index), indent=2) + "\n")

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

root = pathlib.Path("../inputs/transform_files/normalized_files")
files = sorted(path for path in root.glob("*.txt") if path.is_file())
summary_files = []
total_lines = 0
for path in files:
    line_count = sum(1 for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip())
    total_lines += line_count
    summary_files.append(dict(name=path.name, line_count=line_count))

out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/aggregate")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
payload = dict(file_count=len(summary_files), total_lines=total_lines, files=summary_files)
(out_dir / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")

python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib

summary = json.loads(pathlib.Path("../inputs/aggregate_metrics/summary").read_text())
lines = ["# {params.report_title}", "", "Processed files: " + str(summary["file_count"]), "Total non-empty lines: " + str(summary["total_lines"]), "", "## Files"]
for item in summary["files"]:
    lines.append("- " + item["name"] + ": " + str(item["line_count"]) + " lines")

out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/report")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out_dir / "report.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
